E2-2018-T2-P1-S1.trunk: 主句：it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources（比以往更清楚的是，未来属于可再生能源）
structure: 让步状语从句(while)：While fossil fuels - coal, oil, gas - still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply
└ 同位列举：coal, oil, gas〔解释 fossil fuels〕
└ 真正主语从句(that)：that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar
E2-2018-T2-P1-S1.logic: while承认化石燃料当前仍占主导，主句用形式主语it和that真主语从句转向可再生能源代表未来的判断。
notes: while在此表示让步“尽管”，不是单纯时间关系。
it是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。
belong to在这里表示“归属于、是……的天下”。

E2-2018-T2-P1-S12.trunk: 主句：that message did not play well with many in Iowa（那一说法未获许多艾奥瓦人认同）
structure: 主句：But that message did not play well with many in Iowa
├ 非限制性定语从句①(where，修饰 Iowa)：where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation
└ 并列非限制性定语从句②(and where)：where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy
└ 不定式作后置定语：to power their data centers〔修饰 clean energy〕
E2-2018-T2-P1-S12.logic: 主句指出政治表态在当地反响不佳；两个where从句分别用风电占比和科技企业选址解释原因。
notes: play well with sb表示“得到某人良好反响/认同”。
dot the fields意为“星罗棋布于田野”。
be attracted by the availability of…指因某种资源可获得而被吸引。

E2-2018-T2-P1-S18.trunk: 主句：The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up（能源来源的变革速度似乎正在加快）
structure: 主句：The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up
破折号后补充判断：perhaps just in time
└ 不定式作结果/目的补充：to have a meaningful effect
└ 介词短语：in slowing climate change
E2-2018-T2-P1-S18.logic: 主句判断转型提速；破折号后的perhaps降低断言强度，并说明这种提速可能恰好赶上减缓气候变化所需的时间窗口。
notes: the pace of change意为“变化的速度”。
just in time to do表示“恰好来得及做”。
have an effect in doing表示“在做某事方面产生影响”。
